claims.text: Stop the culprit drug; supportive care + lifestyle Δ.
claims.quote: Treatment of pill-induced esophagitis includes discontinuation of the culprit medication, supportive care, and lifestyle modifications

claims.text: If the drug must continue: switch to a liquid formulation if available.
claims.quote: If continued treatment is necessary and an alternative formulation is available, change the medication to a liquid formulation.

claims.text: Take pills w ≥100 mL water while standing;
claims.quote: medications should be taken with at least 100 mL of water while standing

Following reports of numerous cases of esophagitis associated with alendronate, recommendations were established to take the medication with at least 6 ounces of water and remain upright for at least 30 minutes after ingestion.

claims.text: Short-term PPIs + antacids may be used.
claims.quote: Short-term treatment with proton pump inhibitors and antacids may be used.
